verdict.rationale: Lago documents that customers can upgrade/downgrade plans at any time (lago-docs-4) and has dedicated subscription/plan docs, implying some proration handling, but no evidence shows documented proration formulas, credit line-item detail, or penny-level invoice reconciliation. A community question about upgrade/downgrade tracking (lago-comm-3) goes unanswered in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit proration algorithm documentation, sample invoice line items showing credits/partial periods, and any audit or reconciliation guarantee.
